grain: one row per (episode_id, claim_id) for every forward episode evaluated

columns.is_treated: bool — the rule fired on this episode
columns.is_control: bool — the episode is in an overlap block of this claim and is not treated
columns.support_block_id: int — T5 date x liq LOW/HIGH x vol LOW/HIGH, cut within the forward window
columns.evaluator_hash: string — which executable semantics produced this row

why_long_form: 175 members as a wide table would make support and overlap audits awkward; long form counts treated and control with a filtered COUNT
immutability: a row is written once. A changed pipeline is a new data_version, never a correction of an existing row.
support_counts: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_treated) and FILTER (WHERE is_control), on maturity-complete episodes only
